name: Serve a Tray
summary: Sitting on the long box with your back to the straps, elbows by the waist and palms up, the forearms slide straight forward as if offering a tray and return.
steps: Sit tall on the long box facing the footbar, feet on the headrest or the frame.
Short loops in the hands, elbows bent by the waist, palms up.
Breathe out to reach the hands straight forward at waist height.
Breathe in to draw the elbows back.

layers.title: Open and close
layers.text: At full reach, open the arms wide and close.

layers.title: Lift
layers.text: Raise the level tray to shoulder height.

layers.title: Kneeling
layers.text: On the carriage without the box.

cues:
The tray stays level.
Sit tall; no rocking.
Shoulders stay wide.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
